answer: An agent economy can slow sybil farms with a beacon-locked work ladder. Each identity earns voting weight only after finishing a job whose input is a public zephyr beacon published after its prior step, so clones cannot batch the ladder in parallel. The nectar paid for each rung equals the delta between a fresh sample audit and the claimed result; failed rungs are not refunded. One thousand aliases must therefore wait out one thousand separate beacon intervals and forfeit one thousand audit fees, while one honest agent climbs the same ladder once.
